<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <androidx.coordinatorlayout.widget.CoordinatorLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="@color/background" tools:context=".ImageActivity">
<ImageView android:id="@+id/image_view" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:contentDescription="@string/wallpaper_image_desc" android:scaleType="centerCrop" />
<ImageView android:id="@+id/double_tap_heart" android:layout_width="96dp" android:layout_height="96dp" android:layout_gravity="center" android:alpha="0" android:importantForAccessibility="no" android:src="@drawable/ic_favorite_24" android:tint="@color/primary" android:visibility="gone" />
<com.google.android.material.appbar.AppBarLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:background="@android:color/transparent" app:elevation="0dp">
<com.google.android.material.appbar.MaterialToolbar android:id="@+id/toolbar" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="?attr/actionBarSize" app:navigationIcon="?attr/homeAsUpIndicator" app:navigationIconTint="@color/onSurface" />
</com.google.android.material.appbar.AppBarLayout>
<com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView android:id="@+id/swipe_hint_card" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_gravity="top|center_horizontal" android:layout_marginTop="88dp" android:visibility="gone" app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/surfaceVariant" app:cardCornerRadius="18dp" app:cardElevation="4dp" app:contentPadding="10dp">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:orientation="horizontal">
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/swipe_hint" android:textColor="@color/onSurfaceVariant" android:textSize="13sp" />
<com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/swipe_hint_dismiss" style="@style/Widget.Material3.Button.TextButton" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:minWidth="0dp" android:text="@string/got_it" android:textAllCaps="false" /> </LinearLayout>
</com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>
<com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView android:id="@+id/action_card" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_gravity="bottom|center_horizontal" android:layout_marginBottom="32dp" app:cardCornerRadius="28dp" app:cardElevation="8dp" app:contentPadding="8dp" app:strokeWidth="0dp" app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/surfaceVariant">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal">
<com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/btn_favorite" style="@style/Widget.Material3.Button.TextButton.Icon" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/favorite" app:icon="@drawable/ic_favorite_border_24" app:iconTint="@color/favorite_button_tint" android:textColor="@color/favorite_button_tint" />
<com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/btn_save" style="@style/Widget.Material3.Button.TextButton.Icon" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/save" app:icon="@drawable/ic_save_black_24dp" app:iconTint="@color/onSurfaceVariant" android:textColor="@color/onSurfaceVariant" />
<com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/btn_share" style="@style/Widget.Material3.Button.TextButton.Icon" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/share" app:icon="@drawable/ic_share_white_24dp" app:iconTint="@color/onSurfaceVariant" android:textColor="@color/onSurfaceVariant" />
<com.google.android.material.button.MaterialButton android:id="@+id/btn_wall" style="@style/Widget.Material3.Button.TonalButton.Icon" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/set_wallpaper" app:icon="@drawable/ic_wallpaper_white_24dp" app:cardCornerRadius="20dp" />
</LinearLayout> </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>
</androidx.coordinatorlayout.widget.CoordinatorLayout>

name: Deploy to Google Play
on: push: tags: - 'v*.*.*' # Triggers on version tags like v1.2.0, v1.3.0, etc. workflow_dispatch: # Allows manual triggering inputs: track: description: 'Release track' required: true default: 'internal' type: choice options: - internal - alpha - beta - production
jobs: deploy: name: Deploy to Play Store runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps: - name: Checkout code uses: actions/checkout@v4
- name: Set up JDK 21 uses: actions/setup-java@v4 with: java-version: '21' distribution: 'temurin' cache: gradle
- name: Grant execute permission for gradlew run: chmod +x gradlew
- name: Decode Keystore run: | echo "${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}" | base64 --decode > $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/keystore.jks
- name: Build Release AAB run: ./gradlew bundleRelease --stacktrace env: KEYSTORE_FILE: ${{ github.workspace }}/keystore.jks KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }} KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.KEY_ALIAS }} KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEY_PASSWORD }}
- name: Decode Service Account JSON run: | echo "${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}" | base64 --decode > $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/service-account.json
- name: Upload to Google Play uses: r0adkll/upload-google-play@v1.1.3 with: serviceAccountJson: ${{ github.workspace }}/service-account.json packageName: com.sky.wallapp releaseFiles: app/build/outputs/bundle/release/*.aab track: ${{ inputs.track || 'internal' }} status: completed inAppUpdatePriority: 2 whatsNewDirectory: distribution/whatsnew mappingFile: app/build/outputs/mapping/release/mapping.txt
- name: Upload build artifacts uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4 with: name: play-store-release path: | app/build/outputs/bundle/release/*.aab app/build/outputs/mapping/release/mapping.txt retention-days: 90
- name: Cleanup if: always() run: | rm -f $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/keystore.jks rm -f $GITHUB_WORKSPACE/service-account.json
